expected_outcome.description: Approve the change: the signature and session token in the redirect URL are what a presigned object-storage URL is designed to carry. The handler checks that the invoice belongs to the signed-in customer before signing, the URL grants read access to that one server-chosen object for 60 seconds, and query strings are not logged, so no credential leaks beyond what the URL is meant to grant. Non-blocking notes are acceptable; FINDING lines and a BLOCK verdict are not.
